slides.title: Discord Gets You Hired Faster Than LinkedIn
slides.subtitle: The hidden job market is in your community

bullets: Most cyber roles fill through community before they're posted
Discord servers put you in rooms with hiring managers
Visibility beats applications - show up and contribute
Start with TryHackMe, BlueTeamLabs or NahamSec communities

caption: The people landing cyber jobs fastest aren't grinding LinkedIn - they're showing up in Discord servers, Slack groups and community spaces where hiring managers actually hang out. #cybersecurity #community #cybersecuritycareers #cypherjobs #infosec
